Pinch is a census-designated place (CDP) in Kanawha County, West Virginia, United States. The population was 3,262 at the 2010 census.The community was named after nearby Pinch Creek.


== Geography ==
Pinch is located at 38°24′23″N 81°29′5″W (38.406348, -81.484682).According to the United States Census Bureau, the Pinch CDP has a total area of 3.6 square miles (9.3 km2), of which 3.5 square miles (9.2 km2)  is land and 0.04 square mile (0.1 km2)  (1.13%) is water.
